name: dsh-meta-memory
description: The memory half of the meta layer: ONE fused plugin presenting the cross-session memory family as one surface — one route prefix (/meta-memory), one sidebar tab, four tools — over a union of the family's STORE (dsh-memento), its CURATED STORE (dsh-memory-delta) and its ADMISSION CONTROL (dsh-memory-injector). Members are composed by importing their own library modules, never copied and never modified, and no member is deleted or unregistered. The two curation postures are kept distinct on purpose: memento's approval-policy writes and delta's human-only promotion are different safety properties, and a fusion that merged them would be a capability loss.

scripts.verify: node verify/parity.mjs && node verify/gate-control.mjs && node verify/route-probe.mjs && node verify/client-bundle.mjs && node verify/mutation.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify
